newsitem.title: USA: Hayashibara holds 24.1 pct Amarillo stake.
newsitem.headline: Hayashibara holds 24.1 pct Amarillo stake.

text.p: Hayashibara Biochemical Laboratories Inc said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing Friday it holds a 24.1 percent stake in Amarillo Biosciences Inc or 1,232,856 common shares.
The Japanese corporation disclosed its latest position on Amarillo in a 13G filing.
Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with "passive" investment objectives in a company. Unlike 13D filings, those reports do not list the latest transactions.
